workpackage: T01.tool-D-A-preboot (GUI-assisted ADC-check step for DDR1333, option A)
purpose: Have the user perform one OK/apply in the TD 2026.2 (6.2.3) GUI on the pre-built ddrmc_x32 IP instance so that ddrmc_x32_adc.log (the artifact the CLI generate_target pipeline reads first) is materialized; then the developer retries generate_target via CLI and continues the T01.tool-A success-branch acceptance if it works.

cli_side_prepared_state.method: same verified recipe as ddr1333_r2 all-in-one minus generate_target (boot_create.tcl); read-only reuse of 190248 inputs

drc_log.note: content stops at 'Start the check of the banks used for pins !' - same partial state as the earlier r1 sessions

pre_gui_manifest.content: every file in the bootstrap dir with size + SHA256 (14 files) for post-GUI diff

folder_cmd.action: opens Explorer at the bootstrap dir for observation

in_gui_steps: File -> Open Project -> paste the bootstrap dir -> choose ddr1333_proj_boot.al
find IP instance ddrmc_x32 (under ip_out) -> double-click (fallback: right-click -> Open/Configure)
verify the 1333 fields (1333.00 / DDR3-1333J / CL 10 / CWL 7 / 50MHz / 4 bytes / 1.35V / x16 / 2048Mb / ADC path)
stop_conditions: no GUI window within 30s of the cmd
project open error or instance not found
no adc.log at either location within 30s after OK
any cleanup/failure/license/login/upgrade prompt that cannot be cancelled

premise_a_assessment.status: prepared_but_not_verifiable_without_gui; explicit falsification criterion defined at execution time
supporting_static_evidence: 002820 vendor/ip contains the tool-produced ddrmc_x32_adc.log at the export root (the GUI check/apply output shape)

Dependency.tcl drc_check writes <IP_EXPORT_PATH>/<comp>_adc.log at L2228 while several callbacks (cal_onlyacbkby via update_gui_pll, update_sysclk_loc) read it - the read-before-write ordering observed during CLI generate
counter_signal_recorded: ddr_e3 experiment: an adc.log placed at the export ROOT before CLI generate did NOT unblock it - the GUI route additionally runs the check in GUI context and may set internal state the CLI cannot; therefore success is expected to hinge on the GUI actually materializing the log (primary criterion) AND on the subsequent CLI retry
premise_a_assessment.fallback_if_falsified: option B (full GUI generation) or further investigation of the staging-copy/state mechanics; the GUI step must never be recorded as headless success

protection_notes.fresh_dir: the whole bootstrap state lives in a brand-new dir; nothing pre-existing was written
protection_notes.no_generate_no_cleanup: with no Generate click, the generator cleanup paths stay dormant (only log-type files are expected)
protection_notes.no_auto_clicks: this package contains no automation; the developer will never start the GUI
protection_notes.post_gui_diff: developer will diff pre_gui_manifest.json against the post-GUI tree (any unexpected writes become evidence)
protection_notes.pointer_file_kept: _validation root holds a small helper file td2026_gui_bootstrap_lastdir.txt (68 B, sha256 169E6B67E91DC2BCA62635F3441763D805756880558EE6DC03320E12E438D95F); it could not be removed due to the runtime permission system, so it is recorded as an artifact instead

retry_script.prints: root/staging adc.log existence, optional SYSCLK_LOC=H4 attempt, generate_target rc

retry_plan.acceptance_path_after_success: T01.tool-A success-branch parity: product closure (Design.xml/DesignConfiguration.xml/<comp>.xml/.params_*/.ports_*/wrapper/src rtl+adc+sdc/proc+drc+adc logs), derived values (CL10/CWL7/tCK>=1.5ns/actual PLL CK<=666.667MHz), 70-pin vs golden input_pins.adc, ADC points at local file; then two independent reproductions in two fresh dirs with the same frozen inputs (a second GUI OK may be required - to be refined once mechanism is proven) and candidate manifest freeze

limits: No GUI was started by the developer (per dispatch); premise A remains unverified until the user performs the OK step.
If the CLI retry still fails after a successful GUI materialization, the boundary record in td2026_ipgen_20261016.json stands and the fallback decision moves to option B.
